parameters{
	Archive_Folder_Path as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	DHCS_Email_Recipients as string (),
	DHCS_JSON_FileName as string (),
	DHCS_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	Excel_Email_Recipients as string (),
	Excel_FileName as string (),
	Excel_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	Failure_Email_Recipients as string (),
	File_Type as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	LAC_Email_Recipients as string (),
	LAC_JSON_FileName as string (),
	LAC_Outbound_Folder_Path as string (),
	Reporting_Period as string (),
	Report_Run_Date as string (),
	Rpt_Recipient as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	TemplateFileFolder as string (),
	TemplateFileName as string (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		DHCS_PCPA_JSON as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_reportingPeriod VARCHAR(20) = ? DECLARE @File_Type Varchar(100) = ?  DECLARE @P_FileName VARCHAR(200) = (SELECT MAX([JSON_FileName]) FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE reportingPeriod = @P_reportingPeriod AND File_Type = @File_Type AND Rpt_Recipient = \'LA_CARE\')  DECLARE @P_Header VARCHAR(200)=(SELECT MAX(Header_Record)  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_DHCS_LOG WHERE [JSON_FileName] = @P_FileName)       SELECT CONCAT(@P_Header, (SELECT planCode, cin, benefitStartDate, benefitENDDate,   CASE WHEN ISNULL(adultPOF,\'\')!=\'\' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE((SELECT adultPOF FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT WHERE cin = p.cin AND  TAB=1 FOR JSON AUTO), N\'{"adultPOF":\', N\'\'), \'"}\', \'"\')) END AS [adultPOF] , CASE WHEN ISNULL(childPOF,\'\')!=\'\' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE((SELECT childPOF FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT WHERE cin = p.cin AND  TAB=1 FOR JSON AUTO), N\'{"childPOF":\', N\'\'), \'"}\', \'"\'))END AS [childPOF],  lastName, firstName, dateOfBirth, discontinuationReason, providerNPI, inPersonEncountersCount, teleEncounterCount, careManagerFirstName, careManagerLastName, careManagerSiteNPI, facilityId FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=1 AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')=\'304\'  FOR JSON PATH),\',"ecmHCP": \',  (SELECT planCode, eligibleMemberCount, initialOutreachMemberCount, enrolledMemberCount, externalRequestMemberCount, externalRequestDeniedMemberCount, externalRequestApprovedMemberCount FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=2 AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')=\'304\'  FOR JSON PATH),\',"ecmProvider": \',  (SELECT planCode, providerNPI, providerType, adultMembersServedCount, childMembersServedCount, adultMembersCanServeCount, childMembersCanServeCount, CASE WHEN ISNULL(adultPOF,\'\')!=\'\' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE((SELECT adultPOF FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT WHERE planCode = P.planCode AND providerNPI = P.providerNPI AND  TAB=3 FOR JSON AUTO), N\'{"adultPOF":\', N\'\'), \'"}\', \'"\')) END AS [adultPOF] , CASE WHEN ISNULL(childPOF,\'\')!=\'\' THEN (REPLACE(REPLACE((SELECT childPOF FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT WHERE planCode = P.planCode AND providerNPI = P.providerNPI AND  TAB=3 FOR JSON AUTO), N\'{"childPOF":\', N\'\'), \'"}\', \'"\'))END AS [childPOF] FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=3 AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')=\'304\'  FOR JSON PATH),\',"ccmMember": \',  (SELECT planCode, cin, benefitStartDate, benefitENDDate  FROM DATA_EXCHANGE.EXTRACT.CA_ECMCS_EXTRACT AS p WHERE TAB=4 AND ISNULL(PlanCode,\'\')=\'304\'  FOR JSON PATH)  ,\' }\') AS DHCS_PCPA_JSON',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceCAECMCSEXTRACT
SourceCAECMCSEXTRACT sink(input(
		DHCS_PCPA_JSON as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DHCS_PCPA_JSON)) ~> LACAREECMCSJSONFile
